shared_elements: human or anthropomorphic figures in profile
justification: Both show low-relief profile anthropomorphic figures with elaborate headgear accompanied by plant-like or foliate motifs within a bordered panel, which is a generic correspondence available to many traditions. They differ sharply in specifics: B has a single large winged genius with a bucket beside a stylised rosette-bearing tree, rendered with muscular naturalism and neat parallel-line drapery, whereas A shows multiple small crowded figures with fan/feather-like plumes and curling scroll ornaments in a dense, flat, curvilinear incised idiom with no wings, tree or bucket.
